claim: Moving directory watch creation into walker.filterDir closes the read-to-watch blind interval.
reason: walker@1.0.8 calls filterDir before readdir and the old dir event after readdir; ignore checks still precede watch creation.

claim: A provisional pre-read watcher can survive a failed directory read, become unusable after a Windows EPERM, suppress a replacement watch, and make stopWatching wait forever.
reason: Base/head state-transition harness plus Node FSWatcher error/close semantics prove the PR-specific state. The generic dead-watcher bookkeeping flaw is pre-existing, so the finding is limited to the newly introduced pre-read interval.

claim: A symlink created during the new watch/read overlap can be emitted by both the walk and watch paths.
reason: Real-filesystem base/head overlap reproduction produced one base touch and two head touches 113 ms apart; the walk path bypasses the 100 ms debounce and FileMap only deduplicates within a 30 ms batch.

claim: The real-filesystem regression test is a portable red/green guard.
reason: The unchanged head test passed 2/2 against both base and head on macOS. Ubuntu PR CI still exercises the intended inotify behavior, so this is retained as a test-hardening suggestion rather than a correctness finding.

claim: The test's 10 second polling deadline conflicts with Jest's 5 second timeout.
reason: Jest Circus 29.7 defaults to 5000 ms and this suite has no override. The custom 10000 ms diagnostic is unreachable and the uncancelled polling promise can outlive a failed test; an asserted watcher leak was not treated as proven.

claim: The live PR description documents removed timer and TreeFS changes.
reason: The current body still claims 500 ms/2 s rescans and TreeFS miss rechecks; neither exists at the reviewed or current head.

claim: The affected Windows fallback-watcher path was verified before merge.
reason: Both Windows jobs are skipped on pull_request; all manual current-design measurements were Linux. This is a platform evidence gap, not proof of a Windows defect.

claim: The current watch-before-read design was rerun through the issue's literal npx expo install end-to-end workflow.
reason: Current-design evidence used direct bun add with a running SDK 57 dev server and a direct watcher package-manager matrix. This is close but not the exact CLI/runtime path.

claim: The reviewed head fails formatting because imports are out of order.
reason: Verified at 72023ba5. Current head da565715 contains only the import reorder and its check-packages job succeeded.

claim: The new @expo/metro-file-map tests do not run in PR CI.
reason: sdk.yml runs affected package build, typecheck, and test tasks on Ubuntu for pull requests; this package defines test as jest.

claim: Missing ignored-directory, nested-directory, and walker-contract tests are correctness defects by themselves.
reason: Independent comparison found ignored-directory behavior unchanged and the ordering contract correct. Additional deterministic tests are useful guardrails but do not demonstrate a defect.

claim: The new changelog entry satisfies the repository's PR and author link requirement.
reason: The entry links only issue #48950. The repository guide requires the associated PR and author links because publishing automation scans referenced PRs.

claim: The new explanatory comments are a review-blocking defect.
reason: No correctness, performance, or maintenance failure was established from comment length.

claim: The fix must be upstreamed in this PR.
reason: Upstreaming is sensible follow-up work but is not required for correctness of this PR.

claim: Kernel event-queue overflow is introduced or fixed by this PR.
reason: The overflow failure predates the PR and requires recrawl/reconciliation above this ordering change.

claim: The misleading ExpoAsset error is introduced or fixed by this PR.
reason: The diagnostic is outside metro-file-map and remains a separate follow-up.

claim: TreeFS negative-miss behavior changed in the reviewed diff.
reason: TreeFS source and tests are identical between base and reviewed head.

claim: Atomic rename, package-directory replacement, and every package-manager pattern are proven by the submitted tests.
reason: These are useful matrix extensions, but no PR-caused failure was established from their absence.
